rules.law_name: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11; §98.1103
rules.title: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: A person may not sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. A landlord may not use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in San Diego.

coverage.summary: Applies to landlords and persons providing algorithmic devices for residential rental property in the City of San Diego.

rules.exemptions: The definition of algorithmic device excludes software or products used to publish reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or public information without recommending future rents or occupancy; software or products used to establish rental rates or income limits under affordable-housing program guidelines; and appraisal software or products that do not recommend rental rates during runtime operation.
rules.penalty: A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation against a landlord; each month and each residential rental property for which a landlord uses an algorithmic device is a separate violation; prevailing parties may recover costs and reasonable attorney’s fees; the City may also enforce through civil and criminal remedies.
rules.interaction: The remedies are cumulative and in addition to other remedies in the Division or at law, statute, or ordinance.
rules.quoted_span:
(a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic
 device to a landlord.
(b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or
occupancy levels for residential rental property.
